title: Rust Connection Parent Child Hashing
description: Align semio client Rust Side and Connection compute_hash with strict parent/child semantics and structured hashing (Side: piece+connector+designPiece; Connection: optional sorted attributes merkle, parent/child side digests, description when non-empty, numeric fields). Add format_number_for_hash helper in hash module.
summary: Rust semio client: added hash::format_number_for_hash; Side::compute_hash now encodes optional connector + designPiece + piece like strict kit sides; Connection::compute_hash folds sorted attribute merkle (when non-empty), parent/child side digests, optional description, then gap/id/rise/rotation/shift/tilt/turn/u/v with canonical number strings. Added unit tests for number formatting, connection hash stability, and kept relay merkle guard. Local cargo check still blocked by pre-existing lzma-rust2 vs crc crate mismatch in the workspace.
